# The intelligence you trust, wherever you work

Research and decision-making now happen in the models, dashboards, and tools your teams use every day. Get the same PitchBook intelligence you trust, wherever you work, with Data Feed, API, CRM, LLM partnerships, and integrations. The difference is never the data; it’s how your team wants to reach it.

 Access our data where you need it

 PitchBook Platform

 Everything you need to know about private capital markets, from deals to players to trends, is in the PitchBook Platform. Find the data you need to act faster without switching tools.

 Direct Feed and API

 Integrate our data into your systems with the PitchBook API and Data Feed. Feed internal tools, dashboards, and models with live private market intelligence instead of a static export.

 CRM integration

 Bring PitchBook data into Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or HubSpot to score leads, enrich records, and personalize outreach without leaving your pipeline.

 LLM partnerships

 Our partnerships bring PitchBook data and analyst research into the enterprise AI tools your team already works in, including Claude and ChatGPT. Ask complex questions in natural language inside your own secure environment and get answers grounded in a citable source.

 Integrations

 Enrich Excel, PowerPoint, and Chrome with trusted private capital market data. Build the model, create the deck, and check a company mid-browse without breaking stride.

### Move from coverage to conviction without context switching

- ### Reach the data the moment you need it

 Decisions don’t wait for a login, and exported data can be outdated by the time you pull it. PitchBook intelligence is available when the call gets made, so your team works from current data instead of an export someone pulled last week.
- ### Choose the pathway that fits how you work

 Stop losing time hopping between tools to find the data you need. Access trusted PitchBook data using Data Feed, API, CRM, LLM Premium Connectors, and integrations. The difference is never the data; it’s how your team wants to reach it.
- ### Validate and standardize data in internal systems

 Layer private capital market intelligence onto CRM records, internal dashboards, models, and AI tools. Your stack keeps its shape and gains a data foundation that holds up under scrutiny.

## How’d you get that data?

Our team of specialized data operations associates uses rigorous information infrastructure to deliver timely intelligence across a broad range of datasets every day.

> ### “We can now quickly access the data we need without searching multiple sources, which has allowed us to focus on analyzing and advising rather than information gathering. This is precisely why we chose PitchBook—it **provides access to essential information quickly** while assuring us of its reliability.”

![logo_enhance-color-2026.png](https://pitchbook.brightspotcdn.com/dims4/default/1e64934/2147483647/strip/true/crop/477x103+0+0/resize/300x65!/quality/90/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fk2-prod-pitchbook-prod.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com%2Fbrightspot%2F60%2Fba%2Fd1a31d8745f49171b02b471c4445%2Flogo-enhance-color-2026.png)

The connectors run today in Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Perplexity, Hebbia, and more. Visit our [LLM partnerships page](https://pitchbook.com/products/premium-connectors) for the full list of LLM partnerships.

It depends on which connector you use. The Premium Connector requires a PitchBook license, an enterprise license with the AI partner, and an SSO-enabled connection. The Essential Connector provides a limited, narrowly focused dataset and does not require a PitchBook license. Your account team can confirm which fits your setup.

Both deliver the same data; the difference is how it arrives. The API answers live queries on demand, which suits applications, dashboards, and internal tools. The Data Feed delivers scheduled bulk files of full datasets well-suited for data warehouses and quantitative models. Many clients run both.

Unrivaled PitchBook private capital market coverage spans asset classes, geographies, industries, verticals, and more. No matter what your focus is, you can find the information you need in PitchBook, with millions of must-have data points.

Our Data Operations Team consists of 1,800+ professionals who vet, categorize, and analyze the information that we publish. Our data quality is also consistently enhanced, with a specialized Data Hygiene team dedicated to maintaining data precision and reliability.

Our data is updated multiple times a day from sources including survey requests, regulatory filings, and FOIA responses. Every week, we analyze over one million news events to ensure access to the information you need in a rapidly changing market.
